summary:
Soil-IQ is a bilingual (Arabic/English) Earth-intelligence prototype that transforms NASA data into practical, interactive agricultural decisions. Built for NASA Space Apps Field Shift, it connects climate, water, soil, crop rotations and real-world farming constraints in one evidence-aware platform.

The Field Workspace combines NASA POWER weather with Earth-observation resources including GPM IMERG, Landsat/HLS, SMAP and satellite imagery, alongside user-provided farm context. Farmers and researchers can explore interactive maps, seasonal trends, daily soil-water balances, crop screening, and comparisons between a current rotation and alternative scenarios. Guided and Research modes expose methods, assumptions, uncertainty and downloadable evidence.

The Seventh Field brings the science to life through a 3D Egyptian farming story: six interconnected fields, shared irrigation, farmer conversations and decisions with different simulated consequences. Water-allocation scenarios help players explore scarcity, timing, cooperation and fairness, while Earth Lens separates observed data from modeled futures.

Soil-IQ's goal is not just to show data, but to make complex trade-offs visible, explainable and actionable—connecting scientific exploration, scenario planning and immersive learning in a scalable global prototype.
details:
Soil-IQ — From Earth Intelligence to Agricultural Decisions

Soil-IQ is an integrated, bilingual agricultural intelligence platform and interactive 3D simulation prototype developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 — Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data.

Our vision is to connect satellite observations, climate science, soil-water dynamics, crop-rotation planning and immersive learning in one accessible experience.

1. Earth Intelligence & NASA Integration

Soil-IQ brings together NASA POWER meteorological data and Earth-observation resources including GPM IMERG, Landsat/HLS, SMAP, ECOSTRESS and satellite catalogue and imagery services. Its research framework explores climate variability, precipitation, vegetation conditions, water availability and agricultural risks across different geographical contexts.

The platform distinguishes source observations, derived estimates, modeled scenarios and user-provided field information.

2. Intelligent Agricultural Decision Engine

Users explore current and alternative crop rotations through interactive maps, seasonal timelines, crop screening and daily soil-water balance simulations.

The framework considers rainfall, evapotranspiration, irrigation limitations, soil properties, crop stages, feasibility constraints and decision uncertainty.

Guided and Research workspaces make the experience accessible to farmers while providing researchers with assumptions, methods, sensitivity analysis and reproducible outputs.

3. The Seventh Field — Immersive 3D Experience

The Seventh Field transforms complex agricultural challenges into a human-centered, playable simulation set in an Egyptian farming community.

Players explore interconnected fields, interact with farmers, investigate irrigation problems and make choices involving water distribution, timing, cooperation and resource limitations.

A deterministic six-field water-allocation model supports scenario-based outcomes, while the Earth Lens concept connects the physical farming environment with NASA evidence and modeled futures.

The wider game vision includes deeper character-driven missions, seasonal progression and interconnected decisions that help players understand the long-term consequences of agricultural choices.

4. Scientific Innovation and Transparency

Soil-IQ emphasizes evidence provenance, reproducibility, uncertainty-aware comparison, water accounting and transparent decision logic.

Rather than presenting every scenario as a guaranteed prediction, the system shows the assumptions and evidence behind the results, supporting responsible interpretation and further agricultural validation.

5. Technology and Global Vision

The project combines HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Babylon.js-based 3D visualization, interactive mapping, scientific modeling and NASA data services.

Designed for Arabic and English audiences, Soil-IQ connects practical decision support with interactive education and scientific exploration.

Our ambition is to make advanced Earth intelligence understandable and useful to farmers, educators, researchers and communities worldwide.

Soil-IQ — Six Fields. Seven Futures. One Smarter Way to Decide.
